The '''carved ivory bracelet''' is worn by [[Aviendha]]. It is a gift from [[Rand al'Thor]] and is heavy and decorated with roses with thorns. Rand attempts to purchase the bracelet from the [[Far Dareis Mai|Maidens of the Spear]], but they interpret the bracelet as an interest gift and refuse payment,<ref>[[The Shadow Rising/Chapter 50]]</ref> and it is only after meeting with [[Elayne Trakand|Elayne]], feeling that she has met her ''[[Ji'e'toh|toh]]''[[Ji'e'toh|,]] and each adopting the other as [[Aiel familial terms|first-sister]] that Aviendha is seen to wear it regularly.<ref>[[Crossroads of Twilight/Chapter 20]]</ref>
